q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts
web/src/connect.ts
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go
store/memo.go
store/db/sqlite/memo.go
```

How each hop connects:

- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` — `useCreateMemo()` (line 178) wraps a TanStack `useMutation` whose `mutationFn` calls `memoServiceClient.createMemo({ memo: memoToCreate })`, then invalidates memo lists and user stats on success.
- `web/src/connect.ts` — `memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)` (line 197), a Connect-RPC client over `createConnectTransport` with binary format, credentialed fetch, and an auth interceptor. The `MemoService` descriptor it binds comes from the generated `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.
- `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` — `rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)` (line 21), mapped to `POST /api/v1/memos` with `body: "memo"`. Generated Go stubs live in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`.
- `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` — `ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo` (line 306) unwraps the Connect request and delegates to `APIV1Service.CreateMemo(ctx, req.Msg)`.
- `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` — `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (line 70) authenticates the user, validates/generates the memo UID, builds a `store.Memo`, applies optional custom timestamps, enforces the content-length limit, rebuilds the markdown payload, then calls `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)` (line 115) and maps unique-constraint errors to `AlreadyExists`.
- `store/memo.go` — `Store.CreateMemo` (line 109) validates the UID against `base.UIDMatcher` and forwards to the dialect driver via the `Driver` interface declared in `store/driver.go`.
- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` — `DB.CreateMemo` (line 16) assembles the field/placeholder lists and executes `INSERT INTO \`memo\` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING \`id\`, \`created_ts\`, \`updated_ts\`, \`row_status\`` (line 41).

The equivalent dialect drivers are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`; SQLite is shown here as the one requested example.
